D: An amateur stuntman tries to jump fifteen buses to raise money for his stepdad's heart operation.
P: Serve the snacks when Rod lines up the big jump.
S: Baked black bean dip with cheddar, salsa, sour cream and corn chips

Warm smoky black beans mashed with cumin and lime, baked under melted cheddar, then topped with salsa, sour cream, jalapeño and coriander, with corn chips. Fry 1 diced onion and 2 garlic cloves in oil for 5 minutes, add 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp smoked paprika, then 2 drained 400g tins black beans and 100ml water. Simmer 5 minutes and mash roughly with lime juice and salt. Spread in a baking dish, cover with 150g grated cheddar and bake at 200C for 10 minutes. Top with 150g salsa, 100g sour cream, sliced jalapeño and coriander. Serve with 250g corn chips.
Grilled franks in buns under beef chilli and melted cheddar

Grilled franks in toasted buns smothered in beefy chilli, melted cheddar, diced onion and mustard, eaten fast between stunts. Brown 300g beef mince with 1 diced onion. Add 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tbsp tomato paste, 200ml passata and 100ml water and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Grill 8 frankfurts until blistered. Toast 8 hot dog buns, add the franks, spoon over the chilli and top with 120g grated cheddar. Grill 1 minute to melt, then finish with diced white onion and yellow mustard.
M: Grilled beef patties, American cheese, pickle sauce and lettuce

Juicy beef patties with melted American cheese, dill pickles, shredded lettuce and a pickle-flecked burger sauce in toasted sesame buns. Shape 800g beef mince into 4 patties slightly wider than the buns and season well. Grill on a hot barbecue 4 minutes a side, adding 2 slices of American cheese each for the last minute. Mix 4 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp mustard and 2 tbsp chopped dill pickles. Toast 4 sesame buns, spread with sauce, add shredded lettuce, the patty and sliced pickles.
W: Fifteen bus jump choc chip cookies
Soft dark chocolate chip cookies with flaky salt

Fifteen chewy brown sugar cookies loaded with dark chocolate chunks and a sprinkle of sea salt, lined up in a row like buses waiting for the jump. Heat the oven to 180C. Beat 125g soft butter with 150g brown sugar and 50g caster sugar, then 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla. Stir in 200g plain flour, half a tsp bicarb, a pinch of salt and 150g chopped dark chocolate. Roll into 15 balls and bake on lined trays for 10 to 11 minutes until golden at the edges but soft in the middle. Sprinkle with flaky salt and cool on the trays. Line up in a row to serve.
K: Cherry syrup, lime and soda water over crushed ice

Homemade sour cherry syrup and fresh lime topped with soda water over crushed ice, with a cherry and a lime wedge, sweet, sharp and fizzy. Simmer 250g pitted frozen cherries with 100g sugar and 100ml water for 10 minutes, mashing them. Strain and cool. Fill 4 tall glasses with crushed ice. Add 50ml cherry syrup and 20ml lime juice to each and top with 200ml cold soda water. Stir and garnish with a cherry and a lime wedge.
